name: (+/-)-gepefrine
summary: Gepefrine, also known as 3-hydroxyamphetamine or α-methyl-meta-tyramine and sold under the brand names Pressionorm and Wintonin, is a sympathomimetic medication used as an antihypotensive agent which has been marketed in Germany.

pharmacology.text: Gepefrine is described as a sympathomimetic and antihypotensive agent.

uses.text: Gepefrine, also known as 3-hydroxyamphetamine or α-methyl-meta-tyramine and sold under the brand names Pressionorm and Wintonin, is a sympathomimetic medication used as an antihypotensive agent which has been marketed in Germany.

summaryZh: 3-羥基安非他命是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C9H13NO，屬於苯丙胺衍生物類擬交感神經藥。
summaryZhHans: 3-羟基安非他命是一种含氮有机化合物，分子式C9H13NO，属于苯丙胺衍生物类拟交感神经药。

sideEffects.en: Little detailed information is published. Drugs of its kind, sympathomimetics used to raise blood pressure, can cause a pounding or fast heartbeat, headache, restlessness and blood pressure that rises too high.
sideEffects.zh: 公開的詳細資料很少。這類用來升高血壓的擬交感神經藥，可能造成心悸或心跳加快、頭痛、坐立不安，以及血壓升得過高。
sideEffects.zhHans: 公开的详细数据很少。这类用来升高血压的拟交感神经药，可能造成心悸或心跳加快、头痛、坐立不安，以及血压升得过高。

fact.en: Its other name, alpha-methyl-meta-tyramine, shows that it is a close relative of tyramine, the compound found in aged cheese that can raise blood pressure.
fact.zh: 它的另一個名稱 α-甲基間酪胺，說明它是酪胺的近親；酪胺存在於陳年起司中，可能使血壓升高。
fact.zhHans: 它的另一个名称 α-甲基间酪胺，说明它是酪胺的近亲；酪胺存在于陈年起司中，可能使血压升高。
